description: Coverage contract for scripts/qa-layer-activation-matrix.mjs. Every runtime layer id must be listed with at least one network fixture id OR a specific, reviewable exception. The matrix validates this file against the runtime layer registry and fails closed on a missing, orphaned or contradictory entry. The contract block is the ratchet: fixture-backed coverage may only rise and exceptions may only fall without a deliberate edit to those numbers.

bhote-koshi-2026.exception: Bundled 2026 event package (imagery, reconstruction and terrain) ships inside the app; enabling it performs no network read.

bhote-koshi-locator.exception: Bundled GeoPera river centerline; enabling it performs no network read.

local-adsb.exception: Reads a user's own RTL-SDR/WebUSB receiver; there is no server or third-party network source to fixture.
local-adsb.creditException: Receiver data is supplied by the user's own hardware; no third-party attribution is registered.

insider.creditException: SEC EDGAR filings are non-spatial analyst rows; no Cesium credit is registered for this layer.

ai-agent.exception: Sentinel is an analyst assistant with no map dataset of its own; it has no network source to fixture.
ai-agent.creditException: The assistant renders no third-party map data and registers no Cesium credit.

orbit-changes.note: The first enable records a baseline and by design reports zero changes; a second epoch is required before a changed TLE can be compared. Activation, credit and teardown are still verified here.

cell-towers.creditException: The layer carries its ANFR/OpenCelliD attribution in its own source row; it does not register a Cesium credit.

iot-sensors.creditException: The layer carries its openSenseMap/TTN attribution in its own source row; it does not register a Cesium credit.

netmon.creditException: Nodes are the operator's own authorized targets; there is no third-party data source to credit.

private-wifi.exception: Reads a user-selected local Wi-Fi capture file; there is no network source to fixture.
private-wifi.creditException: User-supplied capture data; no third-party attribution is registered.

device-sweep.exception: Drives the browser's Web Bluetooth/USB/NFC capability against nearby hardware; no server source exists to fixture.
device-sweep.creditException: Local hardware scan; no third-party map data is shown.

alpr-cameras.exception: Camera tiles are a signed MVT/OnEarth journey with interactive framing; qa-alpr-journey.mjs owns that data contract, and the matrix still verifies activation, credit and teardown.
alpr-cameras.creditException: The layer registers attribution dynamically when tile data is shown; the exception is recorded here because the matrix does not exercise the MVT journey.

street-level.exception: Requires Mapillary photo coverage and an interactive panorama viewer; qa-street-level.mjs owns that imagery contract.

plate-reader.exception: Runs an on-device plate-detection model against a user camera or image; there is no network source to fixture.
plate-reader.creditException: On-device inference over user-supplied imagery; no third-party map data is shown.

face-privacy.exception: Runs an on-device face-detection model against a user camera or image; there is no network source to fixture.
face-privacy.creditException: On-device inference over user-supplied imagery; no third-party map data is shown.

directions.exception: A route only exists after the operator picks two points and runs an OSRM query; qa-directions.mjs owns that interactive contract.

recent-imagery.exception: NASA GIBS imagery is a tiled raster journey with date selection; qa-recent-imagery.mjs owns that imagery contract.
recent-imagery.creditException: GIBS attribution is registered when an imagery frame is displayed, which the activation-only exception does not render; qa-recent-imagery.mjs verifies the credited imagery path.

military-awareness.exception: A derived view over flights, military aircraft, vessels and installations; it owns no data source of its own.
military-awareness.creditException: Derived view; every underlying source carries its own credit.

local-datacenters.exception: Uses the app's bundled local OpenStreetMap extract; enabling it performs no network read.

local-dams.exception: Uses the app's bundled Open Infrastructure Map extract; enabling it performs no network read.

israeli-transport.exception: Bundled Israeli transport/company reference dataset; enabling it performs no network read.
israeli-transport.creditException: Bundled public-reference data; the layer carries its own source links in the panel.

telegeography-submarine-cables.exception: Bundled TeleGeography cable and landing-point GeoJSON; enabling it performs no network read.
